page_note: Heavily damaged page (90.9%). Content is Mani's first-person mission narrative to Persia — biographical/hagiographic material, not cosmological substrate. Mentions counselors, magnates, senators, satraps, governors (imperial officials, not cosmic powers), the land of Persia and her cities, and Mani's proclamation of "living truth." The "archons and authorities" here are paired with the imperial-administrative vocabulary, indicating contemporary political/administrative powers rather than cosmic ones. No core teaching present — entire page is apostolic-frame biography.
